commentary_title: Market weakness weighs on freight rates
commentary_summary: The Aframax market had a slow week with market activity softening further as the week went on. Despite that, the tonne-miles index showed a slight uptick, ending the week at 97.6 points due to a slight improvement in vessel activity towards the East. | Freight rates towards the West slumped due to a lack of tonnage demand in the Med. An increase in the %laden in week 19 is, however, likely to keep rates from falling further in the next week. Towards the East, freight rates held up better comparatively, but could see some decline next week due to an increase in the tonnage underway.
